content: SSE (WHATWG): on reconnect the UA sends Last-Event-ID = last seen id field; an 'id:' line with empty value resets it; retry: sets reconnection time; HTTP 204 stops reconnection; UAs may add exponential backoff. MDN: over HTTP/1.1 browsers cap ~6 connections per browser+domain (Chrome/Firefox won't-fix); HTTP/2 negotiates streams (default 100). Source: html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/server-sent-events.html; developer.mozilla.org EventSource.
